item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00206","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C13","C05","C20"],"selected_candidate_label":"C13","confidence":0.83,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C13 plausibly supplied a material template for the child’s creation of an expert presidential advisory body. Both letters establish a board or committee of distinguished outside experts, appoint its chairman, charge it with providing independent presidential advice or evaluation across several federal agencies, emphasize assessment of progress and research in fields tied to national security, and anticipate cooperation from affected agencies. The child adapts that machinery from defense-related scientific research to foreign intelligence and adds a recurring meeting schedule and special attention to CIA activities. C05 and C20 also provide establishment-and-chairman letter structures, but their Cabinet committees, fixed reports, and policy-recommendation missions are less closely aligned with the child’s continuing independent-review board.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I am establishing a Board of Consultants on foreign intelligence activities of this Government for the purpose of providing me periodically with independent evaluations","parent_excerpt":"I have therefore determined to establish a Science Advisory Committee ... to be available to the Defense Mobilization Director and to me, a. To provide independent advice","explanation":"Both create expert advisory bodies expressly to furnish independent assessments or advice to the President."},{"child_excerpt":"I would like to have you serve as Chairman of this Board.","parent_excerpt":"I am therefore appointing you as Chairman","explanation":"The appointment language performs the same central function within the establishment letter."},{"child_excerpt":"particular detailed attention ... the quality of training and personnel, security, progress in research, effectiveness of specific projects ... and general competence","parent_excerpt":"To advise on progress being made in dealing with current scientific research problems of defense significance and also concerning defense research matters which need greater attention or emphasis.","explanation":"Both direct the body to evaluate progress, research, and performance in national-security-related governmental work."},{"child_excerpt":"the work of the Central Intelligence Agency and of those intelligence elements of key importance in other departments and agencies","parent_excerpt":"the objectives and interrelations of the several Federal agencies engaged in research of defense significance, including relevant foreign relations and intelligence matters","explanation":"The child adapts C13’s cross-agency, national-security review structure to intelligence organizations specifically."}]}
